---
title: "Timelines/Calendar"
---

## Alaska 
### (Gulf of Alaska, Aleutian Islands, Eastern Bering Sea)

* May - Preview of Ecosystem and Economic Conditions (PEEC) Workshop
* July - Initial call for ESR contributions
* August - First deadline for submissions (winter/spring data)
* September - ESR presentations to Crab & Groundfish Plan Teams - Second deadline for submissions (summer data)
* October - ESR presentations to the North Pacific Fishery Management Council - Risk table development with groundfish stock assessment authors - ESRs finalized and internal review
* November -ESR presentations to and review by Groundfish Plan Team - Prepare ESR 'In Briefs' - Submit final ESRs and 'In Briefs' to Council
* December - Present ESRs to North Pacific Fishery Management Council (groundfish harvest specifications) - Archive and post ESRs and In Briefs on NOAA websites

## California Current

* October - Initial Data Call
* November - Data, Figure, and Text Submissions
* December - Complete Data, Figure, and Text Submissions; Develop Primary Themes and Edit Document
* early January - Complete Initial Draft, Coauthor Review and Edits
* late January - Submit for Internal Review
* early February - Submit to Council Briefing Book
* March - Present to Pacific Fishery Management Council
